LightStatsVisitor.label: Visiteurs Analytics
LightStatsVisitor.schema: CREATE TABLE ls_visitors (visitor_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, first_seen_at DATETIME, last_seen_at DATETIME, total_visits INT DEFAULT 0, total_events INT DEFAULT 0, user_agent TEXT, device_type VARCHAR(20), browser VARCHAR(50), os VARCHAR(50), country VARCHAR(50), city VARCHAR(100))

LightStatsSession.label: Sessions Analytics
LightStatsSession.schema: CREATE TABLE ls_sessions (session_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, visitor_id VARCHAR(64), started_at DATETIME, ended_at DATETIME, duration_seconds INT DEFAULT 0, page_views INT DEFAULT 0, is_bounce TINYINT DEFAULT 1, entry_page VARCHAR(255), exit_page VARCHAR(255), referrer TEXT, referrer_domain VARCHAR(100))

LightStatsEvent.label: Événements Analytics
LightStatsEvent.schema: CREATE TABLE ls_events (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, session_id VARCHAR(64), visitor_id VARCHAR(64), event_type VARCHAR(50), event_name VARCHAR(100), page_url VARCHAR(255), occurred_at DATETIME, metadata TEXT)
